dct_creator_sm: Gustas, Robert (University of Victoria). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2856-2596
dct_description_sm: This data set contains the supplemental information documents for Estimating Volumes of Coastal Shell Midden Sites Using Geometric Solids: An Example from Tseshaht Territory, Western Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada. Included documents include python code used for midden volume calculations, plots of coefficient of variation change, and per site midden volume estimates.
dct_title_s: Supplementary Information for Estimating Volumes of Coastal Shell Midden Sites Using Geometric Solids: An Example from Tseshaht Territory, Western Vancouver Island, British Columbia, Canada
